citations.quote: they tend to remain liquid when the market is down: investors value such stocks more highly

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Acharya-Pedersen extend the CAPM to net (after-cost) returns, decomposing the gross-return risk premium into the expected trading-cost level plus three liquidity-risk betas, so assets that stay liquid in down markets earn lower expected returns.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Liquidity-Adjusted CAPM: Net Returns and the Three Liquidity Betas
